The '''Hyperdrive Tour''' was a concert tour by [[Theepa]] in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]]. It was showcased on some [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where she played at the [[Grand Coruscant Theatre]].

It usually ran for two days, during the weekend.
